description.value: Ipoh Malay Cuisine is a Malaysian restaurant in Vancouver's Marpole neighbourhood, taking its name from Ipoh — a city in Peninsular Malaysia's Perak state renowned for a distinct local food culture. The restaurant offers delivery and sits on a quiet residential stretch of West 73rd Avenue in South Vancouver. Touring cyclists exploring the southern reaches of the city will find it a rare stop for authentic Malaysian flavours.

All amenity fields must therefore rely on OSM tags alone. One notable concern: the OSM email domain is 'penangdelight.com', which does not match the business name 'Ipoh Malay Cuisine', suggesting either a name change or a related sibling business. OSM confirms delivery=yes and cuisine=malaysian; all other amenity fields remain null.
